regions.full_page: Winifred Bentner - 20 - met with fearful bus accident - double frac- ture of skull, concussion of brain, hemorage, etc. This was last November. In June last had paralytic stroke. Last week was given up as hopeless - blood pressure 190. Her brother and Sister promised weekly Communion if she recovered ... She was sitting up next morning. Her face still crooked, Nov. 12th Here To-day OK - Except one eye & side of face slow. Enrolls as perpetual member - as promised for her Jan. 3 .... working every day ... Skating too ...
